general_information.Description: The goal of this course is to provide students with fundamental knowledge of taxation as well as a framework for understanding how taxes influence company decisions. Topics to be covered include: Fundamentals of taxation, Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, Value Added Tax (VAT), Foreign Contractor Taxes, Excise Duty, Custom Duty, Other Taxes in Vietnam and International Taxation.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Promptly access to http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Net-Challenge Simulation Software (CD accompany with the textbook)

description: The goal of this course is to provide students with fundamental knowledge of taxation as well as a framework for understanding how taxes influence company decisions. Topics to be covered include: Fundamentals of taxation, Personal Income Tax, Corporate Income Tax, Value Added Tax (VAT), Foreign Contractor Taxes, Excise Duty, Custom Duty, Other Taxes in Vietnam and International Taxation.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Remembering the tax systems and Vietnamese legal framework for taxation.
Understanding the nature and function of the Vietnamese tax system in society.
Applying legal framework to compute the company's tax liabilities of companies.
Analyzing tax policies and potential tax advantages for various organizations.
Developing a compliance mindset and an awareness of self-updating new tax prerequisites.
Creating an effective tax strategy for the company.
Show the ability of interpersonal communication in business context

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: Explain and give examples about the similarities and differences between tax and fee.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: Explain why globalization limits the role of taxes as a weapon to protect domestic production.

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: Discuss the taxation principles and give examples.

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: Outline in details four types of income that are subject to personal income tax.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: State five types of income that are exempt from personal income tax. Explain why.

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: State the contents of family deductions. Explain the purpose and meaning of family deductions.

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: Which depreciation methods should be chosen to benefit the business? Explain with examples.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: What does “an expense generating income” mean? Give some examples.

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: Why donations, in principle, are not deductible? Give examples of donations that are deductible and explain why.

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: What are the similarities and differences between 0% rate and non-taxable goods and services (exemption)?

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the strong points and weak points of credit method?

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: What are the strengths and weaknesses of direct method?

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: Determine the Foreign contractor taxes in the following case: Company D in Japan provides machines to a Vietnamese company which are delivered at Vietnam’s border gate under one-year warranty term.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: Determine the Foreign contractor taxes in the following case: Company B in South Korea provides training services to employees of Company A in Vietnam including (1) online training; (ii) training in Vietnam by foreign experts assigned by company B; (3) training overseas (Company A’s employees are assigned to South Korea for training).

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: Determine the Foreign contractor taxes in the following case: Company C in South Korea provides machines and equipment to a Vietnamese company which are delivered at Vietnam’s border gate and accompanied with installation services at the Vietnamese company’s site?

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: Discuss the characteristics of excisable goods and services in Vietnam.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: Discuss the characteristics of non-excisable transactions in Vietnam.

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: Why do excise duty rates apply to passenger cars vary, depending on the engine’s cylinder capacity?

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: What are differences between specific taxes and ad valorem taxes.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: What is the essence of the transaction value method in determining the base price for import duty? Discuss the purpose of import duty.

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: Is it possible for the transaction value method to be used between related parties? Explain why.

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: What are the similarities and differences between agricultural land use tax and non-agricultural land use tax?

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: Why severance tax is considered a three-in-one state revenue?

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: Why should the government impose environment fee instead of environment protection tax in some cases?

constructive_questions.Name: HN1
constructive_questions.Details: What are the strengths and weaknesses of Deduction method for eliminating double taxation? Explain with example.

constructive_questions.Name: HN2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the strengths and weaknesses of Deduction of deemed tax method for eliminating double taxation? Explain with example.

constructive_questions.Name: HN3
constructive_questions.Details: What are the strengths and weaknesses of Indirect deduction method for eliminating double taxation? Explain with example.
